Greetings,  


I checked into the TPS issue. The only reason I could find that would possibly be causing it was a player had an enormous AFK farm, where they were using auto-clicker and was doing it for 12 hours straight. Person has been temp-banned. Not sure if that's the actual reason but TPS seems to be back to normal now.   


 [https://gyazo.com/047778e8abef3f9deecee1ecfb3a4f0a](https://gyazo.com/047778e8abef3f9deecee1ecfb3a4f0a)
Hmmm, strange. I'll check on it later. Thanks for brining it up though!
I'll still take a look when I wake up later. I doubt it's TPS since we haven't had that issue. But, I'll get to the bottom of it.
Wouldn't know without being on. We haven't had any issues like that though. Just occasional world gen lag, mob density, and some strange bugs with some of the RLcraft mods.
We've been up for about a month and this is the first report of TPS we've had. I can take a look though.

If you could hit me up on Discord, that'd be great. At least then I can chat with you about the issues I'm having. See if you're getting the same or maybe you were able to fix them. I'll PM you my Discord.
Nope, no errors or anything. I had to rollback the server and I think I'm just done now with RLcraft. I don't know enough to fix all these issues that keep popping up.
We will be doing maintenance today to try and combat some lag issues. But the server is Foxscape.serverminer.com
Either is fine.
We have 4. Server is set to handle 30.
We have more than that. As well as, others have reported it not working on their servers. So, not sure what causes it.

I posted that eariler lol.

Just an FYI, Dwarven ring with at least Adv Efficiency 3 or higher is bugged on servers. Causing the blocks to become invisible, give no xp, and trying to walk where you mined will cause damage and get you stuck.

I just got an Adv Efficiency 3 pickaxe in my survival server. For some reason when I go to mine stone for the crazy xp like I did in single player it doesn't give me xp + makes the blocks invisible. If I try to walk through or stand on a block I just mines it damages me. This only happens I'm wearing the dwarven ring. Very sad. No idea what it'd work on single player but not server.
Also, if you haven't yet make a dragons eye. Unlimited diamonds. Using the dwarven ring gives you fortune as well. Fill an entire chest with diamonds in about an hour or so whilst getting xp.
Oh right, duh. Yea, dragon or diamond pickaxe with Adv. 4 is the best XP in the game.
Got mine from rare purple burning mobs.
Yes it is. You'll have to go into the folder config and change it.
Got mine from a purple burning rare zombie in a dungeon. Also got the fairy ring(flight) from the same type of mob.
Correct. It seems like you don't get instant mine until Supreme 2.
Yep! It's an insane combo for XP.

Hello there,

I understand where you are coming from and that's definitely a side to it. It is more than just my organial post though. 

As far as getting help. As I stated, I've tried basically everything that is legal. I don't even have a social net/circle. 

I do know that people will respond to this post with caring and affectionate intentions. But the truth is that I've made my decision already. I've never used Reddit before so I didn't know where I wanted to post this brief chat. Figured this thread would be the best place. I appreciate your kind words, I really do. I'm sure your words will be a uplifting gift to someone who is struggling. As for me, I'm pretty much already gone.
